The '''1976–77 Czechoslovak First League''' season statistics of the [[Czechoslovak First League]] in the 1976–77 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Dukla Prague]] prevailed as the [[#Results|1977 champions]]. [[Ladislav Józsa]] was the league's top scorer with 18 goals.<ref>{{cite book|first=Luboš|last=Jeřábek|title=Český a československý fotbal - lexikon osobností a klubů|publisher=Grada Publishing|language=Czech|year=2007|location=Prague, Czech Republic|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=232}}</ref>
